name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for med spas?
description: GEO leverages AI to generate and optimize content dynamically, while traditional SEO relies on manual content creation and optimization.

mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for med spas?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO focuses on manual keyword research, content creation, and technical optimization. GEO, however, integrates AI and machine learning to automate and refine these processes. While traditional SEO optimizes existing content, GEO can *generate* new, highly optimized content at scale, adapting quickly to search trend changes and competitor strategies. This allows for more dynamic and personalized content experiences, leading to potentially faster and more comprehensive improvements in online presence compared to manual methods.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO leverages AI to generate and optimize content dynamically, while traditional SEO relies on manual content creation and optimization.
